doc: Region initializers whose initial transition leads into a fork: the root region's (into the regions of P) and a nested one (Q's region, into the regions of R). The initializer's actions are the initial transition's do followed by the fork's outgoing ones, and run when the region is reached.

steps.doc: P's first two regions are entered by the fork, so their own initializers (iA, iB) do not run; the third is entered by default.
Entered from outside, P's regions all start by default.
Q's region is entered by default through a fork: iQ and g1 run after Q's entry, before R.
